title: AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isIso_baseChange_of_smooth
statement: Let f:X→Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let g:Y′→Y be smooth. Given a cartesian square with upper map g′:X′→X and left map f′:X′→Y′, and K in the bounded below derived category of abelian sheaves on X_ét whose homology has torsion orders invertible on Y (Etale.DerivedCategory.Plus.orderInvertibleOnHomology f K), the component at K of the derived étale base-change natural transformation Lg^* Rf_* → Rf′_* Lg′^* is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Use the proved source-library equivalence between abelian etale sheaves and sheaves of ULift Z-modules (Etale.exists_forget₂_mapDerivedCategoryPlus_obj_iso in SixFunctors/BaseChange/DerivedForget.lean) to obtain Kprime and an isomorphism Phi_derived(Kprime) ≅ K. This is transport through an actual equivalence, not a choice of arbitrary data from an unproved existence theorem. For every q, Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso and that isomorphism identify Phi(Hq Kprime) with Hq K. Point.sheafFiberCompIso then identifies their stalks, including the underlying abelian group of the module stalk; supply LocallySmall X.Etale and the shrunk filtered-colimit preservation instance explicitly. The induced additive isomorphism is injective, so addOrderOf_injective transports hK to each module-stalk element.

proof.text: For a module-stalk element x at s, the homomorphism (s ≫ f).appTop followed by Scheme.ΓSpecIso gives Γ(Y,top) → Ω. RingHom.domain_nontrivial therefore makes Γ(Y,top) nontrivial. Since hK makes the image of addOrderOf x a unit, IsUnit.ne_zero and Nat.cast_zero imply addOrderOf x > 0, including the empty-base edge case without an added nonemptiness hypothesis. The integer addOrderOf x kills x. A prime factor p divides this integer, hence its natural cast divides a unit; isUnit_of_dvd_unit gives IsUnit (p : Γ(Y,top)). Thus the module cohomology sheaf is IsTorsionSheafOfPrimes Y.invertiblePrimes, and Kprime has torsionHomologyOfPrimes. This is the allowable-prime torsion condition of the cited definition, in the equivalent module-valued encoding.

Its variables (S,T,X,Y;p,g,e,h) are (Y,X,Yprime,Xprime;g,f,gprime,fprime); the pullback datum is sq without changing orientation. Rewrite the resulting hypothesis by baseChange_eq_derivedBaseChangeMapPlus. Apply the proved isIso_derivedBaseChangeMapPlus_app_forget₂_iff to transport invertibility to the abelian coefficient category, and NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso along Phi_derived(Kprime) ≅ K to obtain the target. These comparison lemmas identify the specified canonical exchange maps, not arbitrary arrows with the same endpoints. The sk-rem-rest unit has no realized statement or proof steps to bypass; the bounded-below smooth-base-change route is retained.

lean.note: The removed upstream Ab coefficient name is AddCommGrpCat. The removed orderInvertibleOnHomology predicate is expanded inline exactly as described in proof step 1: every geometric stalk element of every homology sheaf has additive order invertible in the global sections of Y. No new notion or extra torsion/boundedness assumption is introduced.
